mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 100k signals rising household income and consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the housing starts index below 1,000k units signals weakening residential investment and reduced construction-related earnings, which correlates with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when HOUST falls below 1,000k (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in the industrial production index below 98 signals broad-based supply weakness, which reduces corporate revenue growth and predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when INDPRO falls below 98 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures below $700B signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings and predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when GDPC1 falls below $700B (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals labor market overheating, which increases wage pressure and reduces profit margins, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when UNRATE falls below 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures below $700B combined with a 3-month decline in housing starts below 1,000k units signals a dual weakness in consumption and investment, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when both GDPC1 < $700B and HOUST < 1,000k (t-test p > 0.05).
